about_the_game:
Get ready for a juicy brain workout in Fruit Slide! In this addictive tile-sliding puzzle game, your goal is simple—use your keyboard arrow keys or drag the mouse to move all tiles at once in any direction (left, right, up, down). Match identical fruit tiles by sliding them together and watch them explode in a splash of fruity fun!

But it’s not just about matching—clever strategy is key! Watch out for special tiles:

  • Bomb Tiles – Instantly destroy the tile they hit.

  • Flip Control Tiles – Reverse your controls on contact.

  • Empty Tiles – Block movement and add a tricky twist.

Plan your moves carefully, clear the board, and master the fruit-matching mayhem!

Now available in 24 languages, including:
English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, German, French, Polish, Thai, Bulgarian, Danish, Greek, Italian, Indonesian, Portuguese, Turkish, Czech, Hungarian, Serbian, Hindi, Vietnamese, and Croatian.
